** OLD **
Hi everyone,[/size]

[size=3]Originally I posted this [/size][url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/female-lowcut-shirts-mini-skirt.110494/]mod on the Stardew Valley forums[/url][size=3], but decided to upload it here too.[/size]
[size=3]The aim of this mod was to create more obvious feminine character which lead to this mod.[/size]


[size=3]This mod contains:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]a body replacement that adds a short skirt[/size]
[size=3]Variations: vanilla head and round head2 types of skirts - pleated and plain  with or without socks.[/size][*][size=3]New shirts that show a bit more female curves[/size]
[*][size=3]Replaced Grandpa's bikini with a more modern one.[/size]
[*][size=3]Blush accessory[/size]
[/list][size=3]
Refer to this picture to figure out which file you prefer. Do note that this replaces the female body file (farmer_girl_base.xnb).
[img]http://www.direbadger.com/download/Overview.jpg[/img]

All bodies come with the new bikini:
[img]http://www.direbadger.com/download/Bikini-front.PNG[/img][img]http://www.direbadger.com/download/Bikini-side.PNG[/img][img]http://www.direbadger.com/download/Bikini-back.PNG[/img]

The RuneNL_shirts.zip contains the following shirts:
*Note: these shirts will be added to the vanilla shirts and will replace none.
[img]http://www.direbadger.com/download/all-shirts2.jpg[/img]

NEW Shirts:
[img]http://www.direbadger.com/download/new_shirts.png[/img]


[u]How to install/[/u][u][b]Instructions[/b][/u]
Place the content of the zip file in Stardew Valley\Content\Characters\Farmer folder.
It's always wiser to back-up your old files: farmer_base.xnb \ shirt.xnb or accessories.xnb before replacing it.[b]

[/b][/size]
